ImageDescription.value: Elephant Trunk Hill, Elephant Trunk Hill is located at the confluence of the Li River and Peach Blossom River in the south central area of Guilin City. It looks like a huge elephant stretching its trunk and drinking water, hence the name. Elephant Trunk Hill is the symbol of Guilin and its karst landscape.Location: Guilin.
